name: Everything Bleeds
body:
School necromancy [blood]; Level bloodlord 2, death mage 2, shaman 2, witch 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (a vial of blood)

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one creature
Duration 1 round/level
Saving Throw Fort negates; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You cause the creature, normally immune to bleed, to bleed like a living creature. Creatures immune to most Fortitude saves are not immune to this effect. On a failed Fortitude save, the target loses any immunity to bleed damage and blood seeps from their wounds.

Additionally, such creatures are able to be affected by blood drain-like abilities.
